headline_cluster.headline: ש"ס התרסקה לשפל של 35 שנה, דרעי מסתגר - ומלחמת ההאשמות בשיאה

claims.note: The substance holds: by seats and by vote share this is Shas's weakest result since 1992. The previous low (2015: 7 seats, 5.73%) was higher than 2026. The '35 years' is a loose rounding, though. The election that matches or beats 2026 was June 1992, about 34.4 years before October 2026, and so falls inside a strict 35-year window: 1992 had the same 6 seats and a lower share (4.94%). The accurate framing is 'lowest since 1992' (as jfeed reported) or 'about 34 years'. On raw vote count it is not a low at all: 2015 (241,613) and April 2019 (258,275) were both below 2026's roughly 298-300k. The gap is small and the direction is right, so this is rated imprecise rather than overstated.
